newsitem.title: CHINA: Qian says China will speed WTO negotiations.
newsitem.headline: Qian says China will speed WTO negotiations.

text.p: Foreign Minister Qian Qichen said on Wednesday that China is ready to speed work on its accession to membership in the World Trade Organisation.

"Recently the U.S. side has stated that it would like to see the acceleration of the negotiating process on China's accession into WTO," Qian said at a news conference at the start of talks with U,S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher. "The Chinese side wishes to expresses its appreciation and stands ready to work toward this," Qian said.
Qian added: "It is also our hope that in the negotiations, the U.S. side can demonstrate a flexibility and pragmatic attitude."

U.S. officials had said ahead of Christopher's trip -- the highest level American visit to Beijing in more than two years -- that they were looking for a signal that Beijing was prepared to begin serious negotiations on WTO membership.

Trade is a key issue between the two countries and U.S. officials believe it is critical that China become a member of the new WTO, which governs international trade. Washington has insisted China be admitted on terms relevant to developed nations, but Beijing has insisted that it be accorded the easier terms of developing economies.
